source_first_reading: All nine supplied photographs were reread. The implementation translates the readable principles into a reduced, human-piloted mechanical aircraft; the numerical propulsion, mass and coefficient data are the supplied engineering completion, not claimed notebook data.

derived_geometry.calculation: Use the rounded Say full span 7.4 ft and the original area paragraph S=6.61 ft^2: AR=b^2/S=7.4^2/6.61.
derived_geometry.calculation_wrist: Use rounded Say wrist span 3.7 ft divided by 7.4 ft full span.
derived_geometry.excluded: The inconsistent 3.135 ft wing-length conversion was not used.

photographs.used_principle: Mute swan planform proportions: broad inboard arm wing, rounded/tapered outer hand wing, AR from b^2/S, wrist-to-wrist about half span.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Specimen variation and the handwritten comments do not provide a buildable aircraft structure.
photographs.engineering_completion: 14 m span, source-helper four-segment rounded outer planform, two sliding outer leaves, and supplied mass budget.

photographs.used_principle: Curved-plate/section context is present but ambiguous; incidence, camber and drag/lift are treated as aerodynamic variables.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: The multi-axis graph is low-Re and not safely digitised for full-scale coefficients.
photographs.engineering_completion: The section coefficient tables in engineering.mjs are used as favourable illustrative assumptions.

photographs.used_principle: Bird flight is used as a guide to manned ornithopter design; desired trajectory and force matching motivate evaluating candidate wing actions.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: No final dimensions, engine, or validated stability data are supplied.
photographs.engineering_completion: Human pilot, hills/runways world, and finite 16 kW-class engine model are supplied assumptions.

photographs.used_principle: Straight-and-level flapping necessarily has cyclic lift/thrust and small undulating motion rather than a perfectly steady force.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Marginal notes are partial and do not define exact curves.
photographs.engineering_completion: The simulation computes cyclic strip forces from the shared wingPose rather than prescribing level flight.

photographs.used_principle: At low speed the down/working stroke lasts longer; at cruising speed timing tends toward equal periods; wing/body spring resonance reduces inertial power.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Hand revisions do not give final numeric timing law.
photographs.engineering_completion: theta=phi-b*sin(phi), with low-speed b from engineering.mjs and cruise b=0, plus the supplied spring/inertia helper.

photographs.used_principle: Fore/aft wing motion, closing on recovery, mass-spring wing/body resonance, and pitching moment from centre-of-lift/CG separation are essential.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: The text is qualitative; exact linkage sizes are not specified.
photographs.engineering_completion: Outer leaf overlap changes exposed area while hidden mass remains; generalized forces and pitch coupling use source-mechanism.mjs.

photographs.used_principle: Local incidence and camber are adjusted through the cycle; wing parts and feather-like taper inform the source-shaped outer wing.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: The goshawk section percentages are an example, not mute-swan aircraft data.
photographs.engineering_completion: Separate camber curves and section tables are used without claiming digitisation.

photographs.used_principle: Inner arm wing thickness about 5-6%, outer hand wing as thin slotted curved plate; recovery trailing/partial closing reduces tip drag; conventional tail/rudder/weight-shift controls are acceptable completions.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: No exact tail volume, landing-gear arrangement, or structural detail is provided.
photographs.engineering_completion: A conventional tail, fin/rudder, elevator, three wheels, open frame, engine/transmission and seated pilot are modelled.

photographs.used_principle: Power accounting begins with glide D*V and adds aerodynamic, trajectory, and wing-inertia terms; springs transfer energy but cannot supply net propulsion.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Missing appendices and detailed equations remain missing.
photographs.engineering_completion: Shaft work, aerodynamic dissipation, transmission/damping heat and control work are accumulated from the same dynamics.

mass_and_power_assumptions.note: These are the supplied revised favourable engineering assumptions, not Stanley's measured values.

limitations: Educational reduced model only: no structural validation, CFD, aeroelastic proof, unsteady wake model or human-flight certification.
The wing phase curves are explicit mechanical completions, not notebook samples.
Coefficient tables, engine behaviour, fuel use, damping and masses beyond the cited pilot/engine context are assumptions supplied for this task.
Ground contact is a simple three-wheel constraint with rolling/braking loss, not a suspension model.
